# 8webcom.com

> 8webcom.com is a web development and digital marketing company in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Since 2011 it has delivered websites, web portals, digital marketing and CRM solutions to 2,000+ businesses in India and 10+ countries, completing 1,500+ projects.

Office: 503, Sun Gravitas, Near Shyamal Cross Rd, Satellite, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380015, India
Phone: +91 97277 00459
Email: info@8webcom.com

## Services

- [Web Development](https://www.8webcom.com/services/web-development): Custom websites, responsive development, CMS integration (WordPress, Sanity), e-commerce on Shopify, Magento and WooCommerce, performance optimisation, maintenance and support.
- [Web Portal](https://www.8webcom.com/services/web-portal): B2B and B2C portals, employee portals, vendor management portals, data dashboards, API integrations and role-based access.
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.8webcom.com/services/digital-marketing): SEO, Google Ads and Meta Ads, social media marketing, content marketing, email marketing, analytics and reporting.
- [CRM Solutions](https://www.8webcom.com/services/crm-solutions): Custom CRM configured for your business, Managed CRM, and CRM consulting, with lead management, sales pipelines, follow-up automation and WhatsApp/email integration.
